name: ICTPFactory
description: Used to create a custom task pane.

methods.name: CreateCTP
methods.signature: CreateCTP(CTPAxID As String, CTPTitle As String, [CTPParentWindow As Variant]) As _CustomTaskPane
methods.description: Creates an instance of a custom task pane.

parameters.name: CTPAxID
parameters.description: The CLSID or ProgID of a Microsoft ActiveX object.

parameters.name: CTPTitle
parameters.description: The title for the task pane.

parameters.name: CTPParentWindow
parameters.description: The window that hosts the task pane. If not present, the parent of the task pane is the ActiveWindow of the host application.
